description: List the authenticated user's prospecting campaigns with their pipeline totals per status, including each campaign's objective (goal) and CTA, so the objectives already running are known. With campaignId it also returns abTests: each cadence step under an A/B test with sends, replies and reply rate per version and the rule that picks the winner. Archived campaigns (status archived: kept with their history, sending nothing) are left out unless archived is "include" or "only"; campaignId finds one either way. With campaignId it also returns cadenceVersions: the cadence's numbered versions (the current one and each earlier one people still finish), how many people are on each, and each prospect's cadenceVersion. Read-only.

archived.description: Archived campaigns: exclude (default), include or only.

campaignId.description: Optionally return only this campaign, including its prospects.

name: list_outreach_campaigns
title: Listar campanhas de prospecção
